description: Simplify the component docs, strip duplicated status/measurement blocks in favor of links to the single source of truth, add the ARCHIVED banner to the two archive docs, correct the infra-vs-verified contradiction in the component docs, and run the final repo-wide cross-check. Depends on all prior features so links resolve and the matrix is authoritative.
steps: Simplify nitro-enclave/README.md: plain language, expand acronyms on first use (Nitro Enclave, EIF, PCR, attestation, COSE, CBOR, NSM, vsock, AF_VSOCK, TLSNotary). Keep it ACCURATE to the code: the enclave is Java (EnclaveMain serves CID 16 port 5005; EnclaveService hardcodes source='mock-api', endpoint='GET_ORDERS'); the NSM native boundary is via JnaAttestationProvider (pinned libnsm.so). Keep the honest TLSNotary-placeholder limitation. For verified status facts (PCRs/EIF SHA-256), link to docs/PROJECT_STATUS_MATRIX.md instead of restating.

Simplify sam/README.md: plain language, expand acronyms, keep the deployment units and validation commands accurate. Update the 'read these summaries first' list given that sam/docs/ARCHITECTURE_SUMMARY.md is now a pointer (point readers to IMPLEMENTATION_AGENT_HANDOFF.md and docs/PROJECT_STATUS_MATRIX.md). Keep the fail-closed TLSNotary caveat.

Edit sam/docs/DEPLOYMENT_SUMMARY.md: KEEP the deployment commands and sequence, but STRIP the duplicated status/measurement blocks (the repeated EIF SHA-256, PCR0/1/2, verified request/evidence IDs, Jira) and replace them with a link to docs/PROJECT_STATUS_MATRIX.md as the single source of truth. CORRECT the Nitro-PoC-Runtime block: the verified running enclave name is 'olea-orders-java' (not 'olea-orders'); and add a one-line note that the committed infra/nitro-ec2.yaml launch snippet still shows --debug-mode and the pre-phase4 image/EIF name, whereas the VERIFIED runtime is the non-debug phase4 Java EIF (Flags: NONE) - so readers do not mistake the template for the verified state. Do not claim the committed template launches the verified non-debug enclave.

Edit sam/docs/POC_LIMITATIONS.md: KEEP the limitation structure, but STRIP duplicated status/measurement blocks and link to the status matrix. Correct the stale 'Amazon SP-API ... are Phase 2 concerns / sandbox not used' framing where it implies the sandbox is unavailable: the sandbox is now available for validation (credentials out of band / stored as secrets); keep real-TLSNotary and encrypted-evidence-transfer and the coordinator-fixture replacement as the genuinely open gates. Keep the TLSNotary-placeholder honesty.

Add a one-line banner at the VERY TOP of each archive doc (archive/olea-data-integrity-design.md and archive/dowsure-data-integrity-design.md), verbatim: 'ARCHIVED - historical, superseded by the active docs; do not use as current truth.' Do not otherwise edit the archive bodies.

Run the final repo-wide CROSS-CHECK and fix any failures before completing: (a) EIF SHA-256 246e2143... and PCR0/1/2 appear IDENTICALLY wherever cited and are defined once in the matrix; (b) no doc presents getOrderMetrics as THE financing source without the Transactions + Financial Event Groups correction nearby; (c) every internal markdown link resolves; (d) no secrets/PII (seller IDs, Chinese national IDs, phone numbers, company credit codes, case details, tokens, {appKey}); (e) each FLOWS.md flow matches the code (CID 16, port 5005, source='mock-api'/endpoint='GET_ORDERS', phase4 EIF, placeholder TLSNotary). Record any residual contradiction between a doc and the code/email ground truth in this feature's findings and correct the doc to match.
acceptance_criteria: nitro-enclave/README.md and sam/README.md are simplified, acronyms expanded, accurate to the code, and link to the matrix for status facts.

sam/docs/DEPLOYMENT_SUMMARY.md and sam/docs/POC_LIMITATIONS.md no longer restate the EIF SHA-256 / PCR blocks (they link to the matrix) and no longer imply the sandbox is unavailable; DEPLOYMENT_SUMMARY uses the verified name 'olea-orders-java' and notes the infra --debug-mode template caveat.
Both archive docs start with the exact ARCHIVED banner line and are otherwise unchanged.
The repo-wide cross-check passes: consistent EIF/PCR values, no uncorrected getOrderMetrics-as-financing claim, all internal links resolve, no secrets/PII, FLOWS matches the code.
verification: `Select-String -Path archive/olea-data-integrity-design.md,archive/dowsure-data-integrity-design.md -Pattern '^ARCHIVED - historical'` matches the first line of both.

`Select-String -Path sam/docs/DEPLOYMENT_SUMMARY.md,sam/docs/POC_LIMITATIONS.md -Pattern '246e2143'` returns NO match (facts now linked, not restated); `Select-String -Path sam/docs/DEPLOYMENT_SUMMARY.md -Pattern 'olea-orders-java','debug-mode'` confirms the name fix and the infra caveat note.

Repo-wide EIF consistency: `Select-String -Path *.md,docs/*.md,sam/docs/*.md,nitro-enclave/*.md -Pattern '246e2143aeecb6c2e4f5e551536b2dfc75e8313fd521dd4da91da8f5d907da94'` - every occurrence is the identical full string and the only DEFINITION is in docs/PROJECT_STATUS_MATRIX.md (and the historical capture in IMPLEMENTATION_AGENT_HANDOFF.md).
Secrets/PII sweep: `Select-String -Path *.md,docs/*.md,sam/*.md,sam/docs/*.md,nitro-enclave/*.md -Pattern 'appKey','A2UAXHALACXHAM','x-amz-access-token\s*[:=]\s*\S'` returns no leaked values.

Sanity that nothing in the untouched Node verifier broke (optional, docs-only change): from repo root `node --test sam/olea/functions/verification/attestation-verifier.test.js sam/olea/functions/verification/verification-contract.test.js` exits 0.
Manually confirm every internal markdown link across README.md, docs/*.md, sam/README.md, sam/docs/*.md, nitro-enclave/README.md, and the two handoffs resolves to an existing file/anchor.
findings: DONE: (1) nitro-enclave/README.md simplified - acronyms expanded on first use (PoC, Nitro Enclave, EIF, PCR, attestation, COSE, CBOR, NSM, vsock/AF_VSOCK, TEE, TLSNotary), kept accurate to code (Java enclave, EnclaveMain serves CID 16 port 5005, EnclaveService hardcodes source='mock-api'/endpoint='GET_ORDERS', JnaAttestationProvider -> pinned libnsm.so native boundary), kept the honest TLSNotary-placeholder limitation, and links to docs/PROJECT_STATUS_MATRIX.md for the EIF SHA-256/PCR facts instead of restating them. (2) sam/README.md simplified - acronyms expanded (SAM, PCR, TLSNotary), deployment units + validation commands kept accurate, 'read first' list points to IMPLEMENTATION_AGENT_HANDOFF.md and docs/PROJECT_STATUS_MATRIX.md (ARCHITECTURE_SUMMARY is now a pointer), fail-closed TLSNotary caveat kept. (3) sam/docs/DEPLOYMENT_SUMMARY.md - deployment commands/sequence kept; stripped the restated phase4 EIF measurement block (EIF SHA-256, PCR0/1/2, request/evidence IDs) and the KMS/Jira facts, replaced with links to the matrix; corrected enclave name to 'olea-orders-java' (was 'olea-orders'); added the infra/nitro-ec2.yaml caveat (committed launch snippet still shows --debug-mode, olea-orders.eif, image olea-nitro-orders:latest, memory_mib 4096 - pre-phase4; verified runtime is the non-debug phase4 Java EIF, Flags: NONE). (4) sam/docs/POC_LIMITATIONS.md - limitation structure kept; added matrix link header; corrected stale sandbox framing (Amazon SP-API sandbox is now AVAILABLE with credentials stored as secrets/out of band - not blocked; next slice can exercise Transactions/Financial Event Groups/Order Metrics via the sandbox), kept the genuine open gates (real TLSNotary prover/notary, encrypted evidence transfer, coordinator-fixture replacement) and the TLSNotary-placeholder honesty; full production onboarding (LWA, seller accounts, reports) remains Phase 2. (5) archive/olea-data-integrity-design.md and archive/dowsure-data-integrity-design.md each start with the exact banner 'ARCHIVED - historical, superseded by the active docs; do not use as current truth.' (line 1); bodies otherwise unchanged. CROSS-CHECK (repo-wide, all PASS): (a) EIF SHA-256 246e2143... appears identically and ONLY in docs/PROJECT_STATUS_MATRIX.md (definition) + IMPLEMENTATION_AGENT_HANDOFF.md (allowed historical capture); PCR0/1/2 likewise identical in those two files only. (b) No doc presents getOrderMetrics as THE financing source - every mention (FLOWS.md, SOURCE_ENDPOINTS.md, opinions.md, IMPLEMENTATION_AGENT_HANDOFF.md) frames it as the bounded shop-SALES probe with the Transactions + Financial Event Groups correction nearby. (c) All internal markdown links resolve (file + anchor check over the whole doc set: ALL INTERNAL LINKS RESOLVE). (d) No secrets/PII: no {appKey}, no x-amz-access-token values, no Chinese national IDs/phone numbers/company credit codes/case details; KYC uses placeholders <name>/<idNumber>/<creditCode>/<phone>; the two supplier names are the only allowed test-case labels; KYC endpoint hostnames are public API gateways with credentials stripped (not secrets). (e) FLOWS.md matches the code: CID 16, port 5005, source='mock-api'/endpoint='GET_ORDERS', phase4 EIF, placeholder TLSNotary (proofType=='tlsnotary' + proofHash + responseHash==rawHash), coordinator.py defaults --enclave-cid 16 --enclave-port 5005 (verified against EnclaveMain.java, EnclaveService.java, coordinator.py). Optional Node verifier sanity: `node --test` on attestation-verifier.test.js + verification-contract.test.js = 12 pass / 0 fail (nothing broken). NO RESIDUAL CONTRADICTIONS: no doc now claims the committed infra template launches the verified non-debug enclave, and no doc implies the sandbox is unavailable.
